# Context Kit
> Guides for making AI assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok) remember who you are using one personal context file.

## Guides
- [Home](https://steadiwork.github.io/aicontextkit/): what a context file is and the universal paste method
- [ChatGPT](https://steadiwork.github.io/aicontextkit/chatgpt.html): Custom Instructions, Memory, Projects
- [Claude](https://steadiwork.github.io/aicontextkit/claude.html): Instructions for Claude, Projects, Memory
- [Gemini](https://steadiwork.github.io/aicontextkit/gemini.html): Instructions for Gemini, Gems and skills
- [Grok](https://steadiwork.github.io/aicontextkit/grok.html): custom instructions (steps unverified)
- [FAQ](https://steadiwork.github.io/aicontextkit/faq.html)
- [Why ChatGPT isn't remembering you](https://steadiwork.github.io/aicontextkit/chatgpt-not-remembering.html): memory settings, temporary chat, projects
- [Claude Projects](https://steadiwork.github.io/aicontextkit/claude-projects.html): project instructions, knowledge base, per-project memory
